title: [E-Documents Core] [Peppol] - Enabling EDI capabilities with E-Documents. PEPPOL Order Response Message Handling
summary: E-documents now track order responses and acknowledgements as lifecycle events with a message model, enabling outgoing response generation and inbound order rejection with UI visibility.
key_points: New message model for e-documents to track order responses and acknowledgements as lifecycle events
Automatic generation of outgoing acknowledgements and accept/reject responses for supported formats
Manual reject action added for inbound orders
Message visibility in UI with payload viewing and related message data cleanup
New integration tests for message response handling
quote: Adds a message model for e-documents so order responses are tracked as lifecycle events instead of creating extra documents.
